tests.name: Source and packaged web template
tests.evidence: 11 Python tests passed; the template has one dashboard, Device Grid and Focus Panel, and no Single View or Multi View tabs.

tests.name: Managed noVNC session contract
tests.evidence: Node tests passed passwordless/password authentication, credential cleanup, bounded reconnect, LAN/USB endpoint selection and separate preview/focus quality.

tests.name: Chrome layout with fallback data
tests.evidence: Six demo cards, five-column grid, selection, Focus Panel, no-reload device switching, search and password-storage checks passed with zero page errors.

tests.name: Concurrent previews and focus priority
tests.evidence: A local RFB/WebSocket protocol fixture kept two previews online. At live limit two, the focused device preview yielded one slot, the other preview stayed online, and focus switched without reload.

tests.name: GitHub Actions roothide build
tests.evidence: Run 39113475065 completed successfully with source/security tests, reproducible web bundle, Theos build and package validation.

tests.name: Independent DEB validation
tests.evidence: Package com.dk.viewphone 1.3.0, iphoneos-arm64e, 206 payload entries and four signed arm64 Mach-O files validated.

tests.name: Upgrade and runtime on physical device
tests.evidence: Upgraded 1.2.0 to 1.3.0; one watchdog and one server remained, device listeners reported 5801/5901, and no new crash report appeared.

tests.name: Installed DEB preview and focus through USB tunnel
tests.evidence: Windows Chrome loaded the page served by the iPhone package; current-device preview and Focus Panel both connected and rendered two noVNC canvases.

tests.name: Direct Windows-to-iPhone LAN connection
tests.evidence: PC 192.168.1.157 can ping and resolve ARP for iPhone 192.168.1.158, but TCP connects to 5801/5901 fail. The same device listeners work through an SSH USB tunnel.

tests.name: Multiple distinct physical iPhones
tests.evidence: Only one physical iPhone was available. Cross-device bandwidth, touch routing and 2/4/8/12-device behavior remain unverified.

tests.name: Long-run FPS, latency and memory
tests.evidence: No multi-hour run or glass-to-glass measurement was performed. The dashboard shows dashes instead of invented metrics.
